name: Dot Matrix Bits
description: The grid is a bank of binary counters — each row counts at half the speed of the row below, producing a cascading binary waterfall

variations.name: default
variations.description: Each row is an independent binary counter at a different speed. The bottom row flips every tick; the top row changes rarely. Every dot can be in a unique state.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader in pixels

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of each dot in pixels

props.name: duration
props.description: Time for the bottom (fastest) row to complete one full binary count cycle in seconds

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Number of dots per row and column (n × n grid)
